newLabels.new:activity-timeline: A vertical activity timeline of events with avatars and change boxes.
newLabels.new:awkward-text-wrap: Labels or legends wrap at awkward points.
newLabels.new:bevelled-raised-controls: Tabs and buttons drawn bevelled or raised.
newLabels.new:caption-restates-data: A long caption restates values already visible in the chart.
newLabels.new:card-header-dividers: Cards with a rule dividing a header row from the body.
newLabels.new:card-window-controls: Card headers carry minimise, settings or close controls like a window.
newLabels.new:chart-event-annotation: A chart carries an annotation line marking an event.
newLabels.new:chart-labelling-defect: Chart segments, axes or legends left unlabelled or laid out badly.
newLabels.new:chart-table-toggle: A toggle to switch between a chart and a data table.
newLabels.new:circular-social-icons: Social network icons in filled circles.
newLabels.new:content-clipped-overflow: Text, columns or labels are clipped by or overflow their container.
newLabels.new:cramped-spacing: Elements packed with too little padding or spacing.
newLabels.new:dark-mode-text-toggle: A plain text 'Dark mode' button in the header.
newLabels.new:dark-sidebar: A dark-filled navigation sidebar beside a light content area.
newLabels.new:dated-flat-styling: Flat styling of an older era (circa 2014).
newLabels.new:debug-control-exposed: A developer or test control is visible in the shipped UI.
newLabels.new:direct-chart-labels: Series labelled directly at the line end instead of a legend.
newLabels.new:disabled-primary-button: The primary action shown faded or disabled-looking.
newLabels.new:domain-specific-structure: Content structured by the domain's own conventions (e.g. ingredients grouped by stage, quantity first).
newLabels.new:dot-separated-meta: A metadata line of items separated by middle dots or bullets.
newLabels.new:every-section-carded: Every section sits in its own identical bordered card, often with a grey subtitle line.
newLabels.new:explanatory-chart-caption: A caption that explains why the data changed.
newLabels.new:finding-as-headline: The chart's headline states the finding, often with figures.
newLabels.new:flat-small-radius-cards: Cards with small radius, thin borders and no soft shadow.
newLabels.new:gridlined-table: A bordered table with full grid lines.
newLabels.new:helper-text-every-field: Explanatory helper text under every form field.
newLabels.new:inconsistent-component-styles: The same kind of component is drawn in different styles on one screen.
newLabels.new:inline-edit-title: The page title shown inside an inline-edit focus box.
newLabels.new:inset-shadow-field: Input fields drawn inset with a grey fill and gradient or inner shadow.
newLabels.new:invented-brand-name: A made-up product or business name used as the app's brand.
newLabels.new:keyboard-shortcut-hint: A keyboard shortcut hint (such as '/') inside the search field.
newLabels.new:kpi-delta-sparkline: KPI cards with triangle deltas and a sparkline ending in a dot.
newLabels.new:label-value-grid: Details laid out as a uniform grid of grey labels over values.
newLabels.new:links-as-tabs: Plain underlined text links used as section tabs.
newLabels.new:literal-icon-logo: The product logo is a stock icon literally matching the domain (truck, paw).
newLabels.new:manual-refresh-control: A Refresh button, often with a 'Last synced' timestamp.
newLabels.new:minimal-chrome: Little or no application chrome (no sidebar, sparse header).
newLabels.new:minimal-line-chart: A plain chart with a single line and little decoration.
newLabels.new:misaligned-elements: Elements sit off the shared alignment of their siblings.
newLabels.new:missing-images: Image slots (logos, icons) render empty or as dots because the image never loaded.
newLabels.new:narrow-centred-column: Content confined to a narrow centred column.
newLabels.new:nested-containers: Containers nested inside other bordered containers.
newLabels.new:no-card-chrome: Content laid flat on the page without card borders or containers.
newLabels.new:number-formatting-defect: Numbers shown with spurious decimals or raw floating-point output.
newLabels.new:oversized-hero-number: One KPI number drawn much larger than the others.
newLabels.new:page-in-single-card: The whole page content is wrapped in one large rounded card.
newLabels.new:progress-bars-in-table: Table rows carry inline progress bars, often with a percentage beside them.
newLabels.new:raised-breadcrumb-chips: Breadcrumb items drawn as raised, shadowed or bevelled chips.
newLabels.new:raw-markup-leak: Raw data or markup text leaking into the rendered UI.
newLabels.new:redundant-repeated-info: The same value or fact is shown twice or more on one screen.
newLabels.new:result-count-label: A results count shown above or beside the table.
newLabels.new:row-checkbox-column: A checkbox selection column on the table's left.
newLabels.new:ruled-detail-list: Details shown as a list separated by horizontal rules.
newLabels.new:serif-display-headings: Headings set in a serif display face.
newLabels.new:sidebar-count-badges: Navigation items carry 'New' or numeric count badges.
newLabels.new:single-hue-tint-theme: The whole interface tinted in one brand hue.
newLabels.new:smoothed-area-chart: Smoothed (curved) area charts, often overlapping series.
newLabels.new:sortable-column-headers: Sort affordances on table column headers, often on every column.
newLabels.new:sparse-content: Very little content with lots of unused space.
newLabels.new:stock-sample-data: Tidy invented demo data: placeholder company, team and person names, sequential codes, sample records.
newLabels.new:stock-screen-archetype: The screen follows a stock template archetype (projects table, settings form, workspace overview).
newLabels.new:stock-status-triad: Statuses from the stock set On track / At risk / Off track (/ Completed).
newLabels.new:stray-focus-outline: A focus outline drawn around a large non-interactive region.
newLabels.new:supporting-stats-section: A section of supporting statistics placed beneath the chart.
newLabels.new:tinted-status-pills: Statuses shown as pastel tinted pills, often one hue per status and sometimes with a leading dot.
newLabels.new:truncated-chart-axis: A chart axis starts above zero, exaggerating change.
newLabels.new:two-line-cells: Table cells with a primary line and a grey secondary line in most columns.
newLabels.new:underlined-contact-links: Every email and phone number rendered as an underlined link.
newLabels.new:unexplained-gap: A large empty gap between related elements with no apparent reason.
newLabels.new:unstyled-native-control: Unstyled native browser controls placed beside custom-styled ones.
newLabels.new:uppercase-column-headers: Table column headers set in uppercase, usually light grey.
newLabels.new:vector-map-widget: A vector map widget (e.g. visitors by region) in the dashboard.
